summary: Implementation satisfies the saved profile-runtime health-check wait plan: profile schema supports backward-compatible command checks and HTTP checks; runtime validation waits on declared health checks before post-agent/validate commands; failures carry structured health-check reason codes, metadata, logs, validation-run records, workspace failure mapping, and health-check events; validation identity and API command display include the new health-check fields. Focused tests passed, and the broader ruff, mypy, and unit-test gates are green.
